subject: SIG deliverables orchestration & QA timeline
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsafe.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medsafe.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence intake — initial list

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. MedSafe's procurement team needs to close the SIG checklist and a small set of artifacts before we can proceed with the security review board next month. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following items and an expected delivery date?

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Pen test executive summary (redacted is fine)
- ISO statements / certificate references (ISO 27001 attestation)
- High-level security deck for our architecture team (slides PDF)

Two quick clarifying Qs:
1) Do you have a preferred S3/Drive location we can point to for secure transfers?
2) Are there any embargoes on token-level logs or redaction requirements we should know about?

We can accept redacted pen-test reports if necessary. Happy to coordinate a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Vendor Security
MedSafe Health

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsafe.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence intake — initial list

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Summarizing below so we're aligned and I'll include a proposed delivery/timeline.

What we will provide:
- SOC 2 Type II report (2027) — draft copy for intake, final copy by SOC issuer expected in two weeks.
- Pen test executive summary — we can provide a redacted exec summary and a short scope note.
- ISO 27001 statement — attestation letter and reference to cert (if applicable).
- Security deck — 12-slide PDF covering architecture, controls, incident response, data flows.

Proposed timeline (can tighten if you need):
- Wed 14 Jun: initial ZIP with SOC2 draft + security deck + ISO statement (redwood shared drive link).
- Fri 16 Jun: redacted pen-test exec summary + scope note.
- Mon 19 Jun: final SOC2 as available or shipping confirmation from auditor.

Transfer mechanism: we'll upload artifacts into a MedSafe-specific folder on our secured drive and share a link via DocuSign for access consent (we've used this pattern on other engagements). Link will include access expiry and view-only.

Notes on logs: we cannot share raw token streams tied to customer data; we can provide sampled telemetry and redacted traces for QA. If you need specific fields, let us know and we'll prepare a sample.

Attaching: Redwood-Security-Deck-v1.pdf, SOC2-Type2-2027-draft.pdf (internal draft redacted).

Would you like a 30-minute sync tomorrow to walk through the artifacts and confirm acceptance criteria?

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Deck-v1.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-Type2-2027-draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@medsafe.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@medsafe.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence intake — initial list

Thanks Avery — that timeline looks good. A couple of small asks from our side:

- For the pen test summary, please include the pen test date and whether credentials or privileged access were used; redactions are fine for technical details.
- For the SOC2 draft, flag any known caveats (e.g., sections pending auditor confirmation).
- For ISO, a short line confirming the scope (is it org-wide or limited to the inference platform?).

We will review the deck and the SOC2 draft. A sync tomorrow at 9:30am PT would work for our team. I'll send a calendar invite.

Also, for audit purposes, please include a contact for escalation (name and phone) in case our board has quick follow-ups.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Liam

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG evidence intake — initial list

Liam — follow-up with confirmed deliveries and next steps after our sync. Thanks everyone for the call this morning.

Deliverables (uploaded to secure folder):
- SOC2-Type2-2027-draft.pdf (uploaded) — auditor caveat: final signature pending (expected 6/19).
- Redwood-Security-Deck-v1.pdf (uploaded) — security deck for architecture review.
- ISO27001-statement-2027.pdf (uploaded) — scope: Redwood Inference production services (hosted API and Dedicated runtime).
- pen-test-exec-summary-redacted.pdf (to be uploaded by EOD 16 Jun) — will include test date and scope; sensitive findings redacted.

Access and consent: shared folder link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/medsafe/sig-evidence-2028 (access granted after DocuSign consent). DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.com/docsign/DEAL-8472-evidence-consent

Escalation contact: Marissa Cole, Director of Trust & Security — +1 (415) 555-0820, marissa.cole@redwood.com.

Action items:
- Avery: upload pen-test exec summary (EOD 16 Jun).
- Marissa: confirm ISO attestation wording and provide contact for the certifying body if requested.
- Rishi: prepare a 2-slide appendix for the deck describing our redaction process and telemetry sampling approach.

If you need any additional redactions/formatting for procurement, flag them and we'll handle it.

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com

Attachments: ISO27001-statement-2027.pdf (application/pdf)
